context: Tests whether the agent explores the codebase before writing the ADR, reflecting specific findings (tech stack, existing packages, code patterns) in the ADR content. The task description is deliberately vague about the technology stack — specific details are only discoverable by reading the fixture files. Also verifies standard ADR structural requirements.

checklist.name: Codebase-derived tech stack mentioned
checklist.description: The ADR mentions at least one specific package or technology discoverable only from the fixture files — such as 'pg', 'PostgreSQL', 'Express', 'prism-analytics', or a version number from package.json — not derived solely from the task description

checklist.name: Architecture findings inform the ADR
checklist.description: The ADR's Context or Decision Drivers section references specifics about the existing system architecture discovered during codebase exploration (e.g., the database technology in use, the query patterns, or the existing dependencies)

checklist.name: Correct ADR filename (0001)
checklist.description: The ADR filename begins with 0001 (four zero-padded digits), reflecting that no prior ADRs exist in the project

checklist.name: Status PROPOSED
checklist.description: The ADR has status: PROPOSED in its YAML frontmatter (not ACCEPTED or DECIDED)

checklist.name: Authors field present
checklist.description: The ADR has an authors field in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Date field present
checklist.description: The ADR has a date field in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Decision in active voice
checklist.description: The Decision section begins with 'We will' or an equivalent first-person plural active construction

checklist.name: At least two alternatives with pros, cons, rejection
checklist.description: The Alternatives Considered section lists at least two distinct caching options, each with explicit pros, cons, and a reason for rejection

checklist.name: Consequences split into three subsections
checklist.description: The Consequences section is divided into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections — all three present with content

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: The ADR does not contain unfilled template markers such as '[Driver 1]', '[Alternative 1]', 'TBD', or similar placeholder strings
